tweets.text: I am a fan of Grok Bot but @X is the #1 differentiated data source that it should have access to and it doesn't seem to work? The connector doesn't work and I can't even login to X on the cloud computer. Am I doing something wrong?
I 100% agree with Dario that using AI to cure diseases (and speeding up the regulatory approval of AI breakthroughs in healthcare) could bring 10x the benefit to humanity as everything else combined.
There is no longer an excuse for B2B software to have such poor UX. Thanks to AI, every software product can and should be as easy to use as the best consumer software.
